Interactive applications from my R programming and analytical work. These earlier projects explore spatial data, health metrics, and language models.

Apps open in a separate tab and may take a moment to start. The previews show their initial screens; older applications may rely on services or packages that have changed since development.

## Historical applications

These projects document earlier analytical work. They should not be used as a source of current public health information.

- **COVID-19 Dashboard (2020):** [open the historical app ↗](https://federica-gazzelloni.shinyapps.io/covid19_dashboard/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}. Data currency and current functionality have not been verified.
- **COVID-19 Analytics (2020)** — archived.
- **Italy COVID-19 Map (2021)** — archived.
- **Corporate Reputation (2022)** — archived.
- **Dynamic Panel Example (2021)** — archived.
- **Random (2020)** — archived.

Archived applications are listed as part of the development record and have no launch button.
